title: Weightage of Patients' Feedback on Performance Grading of Nurses
what_it_is: Weightage of Patients' Feedback on Performance Grading of Nurses

sections.label: Nurses' holistic performance appraisal
sections.summary: Nurses' appraisal covers patient care, leadership and development, but patient feedback does not directly determine the performance grade.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Nurses’ performance appraisal is holistic and includes various key areas, such as the provision of timely and quality patient care, display of leadership capabilities and professional and personal development.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: While institutions take feedback from patients and their family members seriously, this is not used to directly determine the performance grade that a nurse receives.

sections.label: Abuse and harassment reporting
sections.summary: Public healthcare institutions take abuse and harassment seriously, staff are encouraged to report, and Police reports have been lodged.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As for abuse and harassment, our public healthcare institutions take a serious stance against these and staff are encouraged to report such instances to their supervisor or appropriate whistle-blowing channels if necessary.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: When necessary, Police reports have been lodged before, for the Police to conduct further investigations and actions to be taken.

sections.label: Bonuses and promotion factors
sections.summary: Bonuses and promotion involve many other aspects, which all nurses know and which public healthcare institutions practise.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Holistically, when we talk about bonuses, when we talk about their promotion, a lot of other aspects come into play and this something that all nurses would know and that has been practised by the PHIs.

sections.label: Training impact on appraisal
sections.summary: Training and support may impact performance and appraisal, but are not the only factor; promotion and bonus follow holistic performance review.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Training may be provided, some support may be provided.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, in some ways, it does impact on their performance and appraisal, but this is not the only factor.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Promotion and bonus are things which will come after looking at the whole performance holistically.

sections.label: Institutions' varying implementation pace
sections.summary: Different institutions may do some things first or faster, and this is a work-in-progress with announcements when ready.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And in different institutions, there may be some things that they can do first, there may be somethings that they can do faster and we are letting that happen.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But, in general, this is a work-in-progress and we will make the appropriate announcements when it is ready.
